function.description: Check cross-chain bridge order status via Khalani. Pass `orderId` to fetch one order's full lifecycle; omit it to list your recent bridge orders (with optional filters/pagination). Read-only.
function.name: BridgeStatus

address.description: List mode: wallet address (optional — uses your configured wallet).

cursor.description: List mode: pagination cursor for the next page.

fromChain.description: List mode: source chain filter (ID or alias).

orderId.description: Khalani order ID. Provide to fetch a single order; omit to list your orders.

orderIds.description: List mode: comma-separated order IDs to filter.

toChain.description: List mode: destination chain filter (ID or alias).

txHashSearch.description: List mode: search by transaction hash.

wallet.description: List mode: wallet family — eip155 or solana.
